From: Emma Clark <emma.clark@lumenhealth.com>

Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot continuity request — PO routing delay

Hi Sergio,

Quick note from Lumen on the pilot we started last month — finance has flagged the PO for an additional internal approval step and they expect it to clear in ~7 business days. The sandbox hits an automatic expiry this Friday, and that will interrupt the team’s ability to validate the integration.

Can Redwood keep our pilot environment active (or apply a short-term credit) for 7 days so we don’t lose progress? I attached the draft PO we just uploaded to our procurement portal for reference. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Emma Clark
Head of Data & Integrations
Lumen Health
attachment: Lumen_PO_draft.pdf (pdf)

Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the PO draft. Totally understand the situation; losing the demo environment this week would be painful.

I can offer a temporary pilot padding while the PO finishes routing, but I need approvals from Sales Ops and Billing to apply it. Tessa / Stephanie — can we approve a 7-day temporary credit for Lumen Health (deal DL-89271)? Proposed guardrails: 7 days, capped at $750 in token usage, non-recurring, and expires automatically. If you approve, I’ll apply it immediately and confirm the activation details to Emma.

Emma — could you confirm the single contact for PO follow-up so our billing team can correlate the final invoice?

– Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive
